literal.prompt: Какое море Южного океана лежит к востоку от Антарктического полуострова?

literalGroups.primaryGround: AWI locates the Weddell Sea east of the Antarctic Peninsula in the Atlantic sector of Antarctica. The Australian Antarctic Program names the Bellingshausen and Ross seas within the Antarctic sea-ice context; NPI locates Barents Sea in the Arctic. The four alternatives are all seas.
literalGroups.locator: AWI L2282-L2283; AAP L302; NPI L2

literalGroups.literal: Это море Уэдделла. Зимой лёд покрывает около трёх четвертей его акватории.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AWI says sea ice covers roughly three quarters of the Weddell Sea in winter. This directly supports the seasonal ice detail.

literalGroups.literal: Летом морской лёд в основном сохраняется в южной части моря Беллинсгаузена.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Australian Antarctic Program states that in southern summer sea ice is mostly confined to, among other regions, the southern Bellingshausen Sea.

literalGroups.literal: Море Уэдделла лежит в атлантическом секторе Антарктики, к востоку от Антарктического полуострова.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AWI places the Weddell Sea east of the Antarctic Peninsula and identifies it as part of the Atlantic sector of Antarctica.

literalGroups.literal: Баренцево море простирается на север до 80° северной широты.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NPI describes the Barents Sea as extending north from Northern Norway/Russia to 80 degrees. This note states the northern limit.

literalGroups.literal: Трансантарктические горы доходят до северо-западного угла моря Росса.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Australian Antarctic Program places the northwestern corner of the Ross Sea at the Transantarctic Mountains.

absoluteDifficulty.assessment: MEDIUM: an adult familiar with Antarctic geography can identify the Weddell Sea by its location east of the Antarctic Peninsula.
